$comment: #1805 folder import: the one list of names skipped at any depth, the file types a folder import reads, and the default caps. noevia-core owns it; noevia-web keeps a byte-identical pinned copy. All caps are defaults the server's env overrides (PROJECT_SOURCE_LIMIT, PROJECT_DOCUMENT_LIMIT, PROJECT_IMAGE_LIMIT, FOLDER_IMPORT_MAX_FILES, FOLDER_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES); the server sends the values in force with every plan. A folder import's file cap defaults to the project source limit.
